name: Old Cape Charles Lighthouse
description: One of the oldest surviving lighthouses on the Chesapeake Bay. Guided mariners for over a century.

name: Bayside Railroad Depot
description: Former terminus of the New York, Philadelphia and Norfolk Railroad. Brought tourism to the Eastern Shore.

name: Kiptopeke State Park Battery
description: WWII coastal defense battery. Concrete ships were sunk here to create a breakwater.

name: Onancock Wharf
description: One of the oldest continuously operating ports on the Eastern Shore. Historic steamboat landing.

name: Chincoteague Pony Penning Site
description: Annual pony swim tradition site. Wild horses of Assateague are rounded up and swum across the channel.

name: Tangier Island Historic District
description: Historic fishing village preserving a unique English dialect and way of life from colonial times.

name: Belle Grove Plantation
description: Birthplace of President James Madison. Beautifully preserved Federal-era plantation manor.

name: Snickers Gap
description: Historic mountain gap used by settlers moving west. Part of the original Route 7 corridor.
